source_split: Exact frozen FMP-v1 original LOCO train IDs; DEV and other normal-train reserved IDs excluded; official validation/good for calibration; original test/good+logical_anomalies only
training_supervision: RGB normal training images only; no component labels, masks, test labels or anomaly training images

ComAD.frontend: released DINO ViT-Small patch8 generic pretrained model;224square ImageNet-normalized RGB;1% per-image greedy coreset with128D projection;normal TRAIN patch KMeans K5/n_init10/seed42; released CRF2iterations
ComAD.scorer: released training-only background filtering, area/color features, component histograms, DBSCAN eps .1mean/min_samples10,5NN global and component scores
ComAD.compatibility: np.float alias; define all-DBSCAN-noise distance return; skip unsupported components with<5 train instances; no test-selected parameters
ComAD.fit_scope: normal TRAIN only; calibration normal validation; all5types same frozen recipe

PUAD.teacher: frozen generic ImageNet-distilled SALAD/EfficientAD-M teacher; no domain warm start
PUAD.fresh_training: new student768 and autoencoder384 percategory; normal TRAIN only;70000steps;batch1;Adam lr1e-4 wd1e-5;lr1e-5 at66500;hard .999 teacher/student loss + teacher/AE and AE/student losses; bfloat16 forwards and FP32 losses/weights;FP32 inference
PUAD.adaptation: extra ImageNet penalty images unavailable/omitted, matching cross-scene local adapter; no claim of exact full original training reproduction
PUAD.statistics: teacher channel mean/std and released PUAD student feature LedoitWolf covariance from normal TRAIN; mapq90/q99.5 and scoremean/std from independent normal validation
PUAD.score: released standardized EfficientAD maximum map + standardized global Mahalanobis score
PUAD.checkpoint: fixed final70000steps; no test intermediate selection; resumes only own checkpoints

threshold: percategory normal validation score q95(higher),strict score>threshold; no test-optimal F1
freeze: source/inputs/generic weights before fits; fit statistics/models/calibration before each category test; no recipe changes from test errors
aggregation: macro5 AUROC/F1/recall/FPR, percategory and perimage; methods reported separately only when all5complete
limitations: Public test set inspected in previous development; retrospective non-blind supplement.
LOCO ComAD uses original unsupervised DINO/CRF frontend; current VID/Auto ComAD adapter uses R3 component maps; disclose frontend differences.
PUAD is a local adaptation due absent extra ImageNet penalty image dataset.
resource_policy: two supplemental workers on GPUs1/2 with modest VRAM; preserve all running FMP, SALAD/PUAD cross-scene and Qwen jobs; no AutoVI missing experiments
